content.user_title: Discover Open Source Issues Worth Solving
content.value_statement: Finding active repositories and suitable issues requires repeated GitHub research. OSS Hunter searches popular projects and organizes promising contribution opportunities.
actual_capabilities: Searches GitHub for repositories with more than 1,000 stars and recent activity.
Selects up to ten repositories from GitHub search results.
Retrieves up to three help wanted issues from each selected repository.
Prints repository names, star counts, issue numbers, titles, and links.
Guides agents to assess issue impact, complexity, reproducibility, and maintainer activity.
limitations: The included script requires an installed and authenticated GitHub CLI.
The repository search uses a fixed activity date and may become outdated.
The script searches only the help wanted label and does not inspect issue code.
Results do not guarantee issue availability, implementation feasibility, or pull request acceptance.

use_cases.title: Find a First Contribution
use_cases.description: Locate active repositories with labeled issues that offer a clear starting point.

use_cases.title: Build a Contribution Backlog
use_cases.description: Collect promising issues across popular projects for later technical review.

use_cases.title: Research Community Opportunities
use_cases.description: Compare repositories, issue activity, and maintainer patterns before assigning contribution work.

prompt_templates.title: Find Beginner Issues
prompt_templates.prompt: Find active AI repositories with help wanted issues. List the clearest beginner opportunities with links and brief reasons.
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer wants a manageable first contribution.

prompt_templates.title: Search One Repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [owner/repository] for open help wanted issues. Rank them by clarity, likely impact, and implementation effort.
prompt_templates.scenario: A contributor already selected a project.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Contribution Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Find contribution opportunities in [topic]. Compare repository activity, issue scope, maintainer responsiveness, and likely mergeability.
prompt_templates.scenario: A contributor needs to choose among several projects.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Contribution Dossier
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a dossier for the strongest [topic] opportunity. Include evidence, affected users, reproduction steps, probable cause, fix strategy, risks, and confidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: An experienced contributor needs an implementation-ready assessment.

output_examples.input: Find help wanted issues in active AI repositories.
output: Project: owner/repository, with its current star count.
Issue: number, title, and direct GitHub link.
Assessment: why the issue appears suitable and what requires verification.

output_examples.input: Compare three issue options for a quick contribution.
output_examples.output: A ranked shortlist describing scope, likely effort, project activity, maintainer signals, and confidence for each issue.

output_examples.input: Prepare a dossier for one selected issue.
output_examples.output: A concise report covering project context, issue evidence, probable cause, proposed fix, validation steps, risks, and confidence.

best_practices: Confirm that each issue remains open and unassigned before starting work.
Read contribution guidelines and recent pull requests before estimating mergeability.
Validate reproduction steps and repository activity with current GitHub data.
anti_patterns: Do not treat star count as proof that maintainers will accept a contribution.
Do not claim a root cause without inspecting the relevant code and issue evidence.
Do not begin implementation before checking issue ownership and project contribution rules.

faq.question: Does OSS Hunter modify repositories?
faq.answer: No. The included workflow searches GitHub and reports opportunities. It does not clone repositories, edit files, or submit pull requests.

faq.question: Does the script require GitHub authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The GitHub CLI must be installed and authenticated for API and issue queries.

faq.question: Which issue labels does the script search?
faq.answer: The included script searches the help wanted label. The guidance also suggests other labels for manual or agent-assisted research.

faq.question: How are trending repositories selected?
faq.answer: The script searches repositories with more than 1,000 stars and activity after its configured date, then sorts by stars.

faq.question: Can it guarantee that a pull request will be accepted?
faq.answer: No. Maintainers control issue assignment, review, and acceptance. Verify project policies and communicate before investing significant effort.

faq.question: Can I focus on a specific technology?
faq.answer: Yes. State the topic or repository in the prompt, then verify the resulting GitHub queries and issue relevance.
